selection: Minimize tuning-set counted disagreements, then invalid queries, then log-distance of parameters from defaults (area first). Holdout models do not select parameters.

reference_config.model_selection: PCG64 choice without replacement; eligible IDs sorted numerically
reference_config.point_sampling: PCG64 SeedSequence([seed, file_id]); uniform original axis-aligned bbox
reference_config.sign_w: 2 * numpy.rint(fast_winding_number) - 1; ties to even; no clipping
reference_config.primary_percent: 100 * count(sign_p != sign_w AND d > cutoff) / num_points
reference_config.timing_scope: One full batch call per method per model, including internal setup; no warmup
